purpose: Show-specific preferences learned from human operations decisions. These preferences are knowledge only until Jessie approves a rule change.

preferences.summary: Calendar may show 4:00-5:00 PM ET because pre-show starts at 4:00 PM ET and livestream begins at 4:15 PM ET. This is valid when the description confirms the 4:15 PM live start.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: For Deconstructing Data, treat 4:00 PM ET calendar start as valid pre-show if description states livestream begins at 4:15 PM ET.

preferences.summary: Deconstructing Data may have a per-episode Google Doc script created before the show. When that script exists, treat it as a production source of truth for final title, formatted topics, StreamYard link, and timing instead of relying only on the raw HighLevel submission.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: For Deconstructing Data drafts, look up the episode script URL first and prefer script fields over raw HighLevel title/topics when the script is available.

preferences.summary: When a replacement guest steps in manually and bypasses HighLevel, classify episode readiness as waiting on replacement guest topics before LinkedIn event, calendar update, and emails.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Support manually confirmed replacement guests who bypass HighLevel and recommend adding them to HighLevel later.

preferences.summary: WinsDay is gated through LinkedIn first because LinkedIn provides the privacy-policy flow. After LinkedIn is created, the show is added to StreamYard with additional destinations including Facebook and YouTube.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: For WinsDay, order draft-first operator workflow as LinkedIn -> StreamYard -> Google Calendar -> Hannah emails -> completion verification.

preferences.summary: WinsDay calendar location should be StreamYard, and the calendar description should include StreamYard, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, title, topics, guest names, and logistics.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Use a WinsDay-specific calendar draft template that lists all destination links and day-of logistics.

preferences.summary: Hannah sends the final-details email the night before and the reminder email on the day of show for WinsDay.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Label WinsDay email drafts as night-before final details and day-of reminder.

preferences.summary: When Google Calendar has an event but related HighLevel context appears canceled, classify as Needs Human Verification unless a human-confirmed active exception exists.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Support human-confirmed active exceptions before stale/orphaned classification.

preferences.summary: Treat uncertain July guest records as needing guest confirmation or pitch follow-up before readiness.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Promote to show-specific readiness state after repeated confirmation.

preferences.summary: If an Apparel with Purpose show within 30 days has no confirmed active guest, alert Needs Guest Replacement and recommend Write PR pitch / find replacement guest.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Promote show_needs_guest_replacement alert for Cherry Willow/Apparel with Purpose after another confirmation.

preferences.summary: If a guest appears confirmed in Google Calendar but canceled in HighLevel, classify as Needs Human Follow-Up until the records are reconciled.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Promote Needs Human Follow-Up status for HighLevel/Calendar disagreements after repeated confirmation.

preferences.summary: A human-confirmed calendar event can be valid even if the audit cannot match an active HighLevel booking.
preferences.suggested_rule_update: Consider a manual-confirmation source file if this happens again.
